title: Verify the db-models secrets-scanning control with probe-sdlc and reconcile the finding
description: After tasks 1 and 2 are on master, re-run the probe-sdlc workflow for company example-co, application db-models (node .claude/scripts/run-headless.mjs --workflow probe-sdlc --company example-co --app db-models) and confirm it detects the tracked .pre-commit-config.yaml and reports the local gitleaks hook as satisfying the policy secrets gate for onfinance-db-model-master.
